rules.rule: a record whose first heading is not a level 1 heading and whose front matter has no title
a record in which no heading matches a section of any layout (Nygard, MADR)
a section of the layout of a record at level required (finding at error) or recommended (finding at notice) for which no heading matches one of its aliases

a heading other than the title under which, down to the next heading at its level or above, there is no paragraph, list, table, code block or block quote, or where every piece of text is nothing but placeholders
a placeholder of the list (10 phrases), or text in curly braces as the MADR template writes the parts to fill in, in a heading or in text of any section, outside code, quotes and links
a record of a layout that needs a status (Nygard) with no status in its front matter, in a section headed Status, or on a "Status:" line before its first section
a status whose first word is not one of proposed, accepted, rejected, deprecated, superseded and draft, or a status given more than once in the front matter
a record with the status proposed and a number n, when at least 3 records with a number greater than n have the status accepted or rejected
a record with the status superseded whose status holds neither a relative link to another record of the folder nor an ADR number ("ADR-0005", "ADR 5") of another record of the folder

an inline link, an image or a link reference definition outside code whose destination is a relative path to a name in the folder, and no regular file of the folder has that name; links that leave the folder are never followed, and web addresses are never fetched
two or more records whose file names give the same number (the digits after the prefix "", or at the start of the name)
two or more records whose titles are the same once a leading "ADR 9:" or "9." is left out, case is ignored and punctuation is read as a space
a run of whole numbers between the lowest and the highest record number that no record has
a record whose file name does not follow NNNN-title-with-dashes.md: exactly 4 digits, the separator "-", words of lowercase letters a to z and digits joined by "-", and the extension .md
